Dear Miss Yonge	
[I ](../persons.html#939)think I have got a most charming gem of Alexander, whom I was contemplating as one [vignette](../others.html#167). I am afraid he was rather an unworthy in some ways.

But who is always worthy.[^1] This face is so beautiful.

It is engraved by Worship[?] from the Besborough [sic] Collection.

You shall see it.

Very faithfully yours
A.

Macmillan

[^1]: CMY was compiling her [Book of Worthies](../books.html#80).
